title: Biologically Inspired Coordination of Parameter Selection and Update Strength for Language Model Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2604.00533v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Adapting a source-trained language model to a target task requires deciding which parameters to update and how strongly when learning signals are uncertain. We introduce Synapse Consolidation (SyCo), a biologically inspired framework that coordinates these two controls. Rac1-associated forgetting and memory-trace redistribution motivate retaining selected source-derived low-rank components while resetting others for target adaptation. MAPK-associated signal processing motivates combining multiple prediction-based indicators over time to regulate update strength. SyCo combines these controls with a structured consistency objective and a small, fixed buffer of labelled source examples. Target labels are not used during adaptation. We evaluate the framework in Multi-source Open-set Adaptation (MOA), using source-initialized target learners for tasks absent from source training and for perturbed held-out inputs from source tasks. translated_title: 受生物学启发的语言模型适配中参数选择与更新强度的协同调控
translated_abstract: 将在源任务上训练的语言模型适配到目标任务时，需要在学习信号不确定的情况下决定更新哪些参数以及更新的强度。我们提出了突触巩固框架，这是一个受生物学启发的框架，用于协调这两种控制机制。与Rac1相关的遗忘和记忆痕迹重分布机制启发了在目标适配时保留选定的、源自源任务的低秩分量，同时重置其他分量。与MAPK相关的信号处理机制启发了随时间结合多个基于预测的指标来调节更新强度。SyCo将这些控制机制与结构化一致性目标以及一个小型固定的带标签源样本缓冲区相结合。在适配过程中不使用目标标签。我们在多源开放集适配（MOA）场景中评估该框架，使用源任务初始化的目标学习器来处理源训练中未出现的任务以及来自源任务的经扰动保留输入。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了受生物学启发的SyCo框架，通过协调参数选择（基于Rac1遗忘机制保留选定的源低秩分量）与更新强度调节（基于MAPK信号机制结合多个预测指标），在不使用目标标签的情况下实现语言模型向目标任务的有效适配。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SyCo, a biologically inspired framework that coordinates parameter selection (retaining selected source-derived low-rank components via Rac1-associated forgetting) and update strength regulation (via MAPK-associated signal processing with multiple prediction-based indicators) to adapt language models to target tasks without using target labels.
